raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms, ammunition, optics, and related components to the US market, this reduces certain licensing burdens but does not eliminate core obligations: items remain subject to the US export control regime, and US importers still face ATF, FCC (Part 15/18 for electronic sights and RF devices), and Section 301 tariff exposure. Exporters should re-verify ECCN classification, license exceptions, and end-user/end-use screening, and align commercial documents with US HTS codes. Note that China-origin firearms and ammunition may face separate US import restrictions and tariff actions; confirm current Federal Register notices before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国市场出口枪支、弹药、光学瞄具及相关部件的中国出口商而言，这减少了部分许可负担，但并未消除核心义务：相关物项仍受美国出口管制体系约束，美国进口商仍面临ATF、FCC（电子瞄具及射频设备适用Part 15/18）以及301关税风险。出口商应重新核实ECCN分类、许可例外及最终用户/最终用途筛查，并使商业单据与美国HTS编码保持一致。需注意，中国原产枪支弹药可能面临美国单独的进口限制和关税措施，发运前应确认最新的《联邦公报》公告。

checklist.desc: Re-confirm ECCN for firearms, ammunition, and parts under the restored rule; check whether license exceptions (e.g., RPL, TMP) now apply and document the classification rationale.
For electronic optics, night vision, and RF-enabled accessories, verify FCC Part 15/18 conformity, supplier FCC IDs, and modular approval status before US entry.
Map each item to the 10-digit US HTS line, check Section 301 lists and additional duty rates, and document country of origin and value build-up.
Run restricted party and Entity List screening for all US consignees; retain end-user and end-use statements and license exception records.
Confirm ATF import permit requirements and any state-level firearms restrictions; coordinate with the US importer of record before booking.
Ensure invoices state full description, HTS code, origin, and value; prepare a non-manipulation/origin statement to support customs clearance and tariff assessment.
